### First Horizon Executive Amy Perry Named Woman of Impact by the Mid-South Chapter of the American Heart Association


August 28, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/903615748/files/doc_news/First-Horizon-Executive-Amy-Perry-Named-Woman-of-Impact-by-the-Mid-South-Chapter-of-the-American-Heart-Association-2026.pdf)


MEMPHIS, Tenn.


, Aug. 28, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- First Horizon Corporation (NYSE: FHN) is pleased to announce that Amy Perry, Executive Vice President and Operations Executive, has been named a 2026 Woman of Impact by the Mid-South Chapter of the American Heart Association and Go Red for Women.


In 2026, the sixth annual Woman of Impact campaign brought together 11 influential women to raise funds and awareness across the Memphis community, supporting the American Heart Association's mission to improve health and spread hope. This year's cohort raised a record-breaking $260,000 to support efforts focused on heart disease, stroke prevention and community health.


For Perry, raising awareness about cardiovascular health is the primary reason she chose to participate. Her family's experiences have made prevention and awareness especially meaningful.


"Heart disease and stroke and have affected my family in deeply personal ways," said Amy Perry, Executive Vice President and Operations Executive for First Horizon Corporation. "My mother battled high blood pressure, tachycardia and angina when I was growing up. As a teenager, I lost my father unexpectedly after he suffered a massive stroke and, years later, my brother died of a heart attack in his early 60s. These experiences have reinforced the importance of understanding our risk factors, how to recognize warning signs and the actions we all can take to protect our cardiovascular health."


In her role at First Horizon, Perry's leadership supports the company's commitment to serving clients, colleagues and communities across its footprint. Perry's dedication has earned her recognition on the Memphis Business Journal's Super Women in Business list and as a member of one of American Banker's Most Powerful Women in Banking Top Teams. Under her leadership, First Horizon Operations has been recognized with a Commitment Award from the Tennessee Center for Performance Excellence.


To learn more about the American Heart Association and how you can support Go Red for Women, visit[www.goredforwomen.org](https://firsthorizon-my.sharepoint.com/personal/keri_bonfili_firsthorizon_com/Documents/Media%20Releases/2026%20Awards/American%20Heart%20Association/Woman%20of%20Impact/www.goredforwomen.org) .


**About First Horizon** First Horizon Corp. (NYSE:


FHN ), with $84.4 billion in assets as of June 30, 2026, is a leading regional financial services company, dedicated to helping our clients, communities and associates unlock their full potential with capital and counsel. Headquartered in Memphis, TN, the banking subsidiary First Horizon Bank operates in 12 states concentrated in the southern U.S. The Company and its subsidiaries offer commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services. First Horizon has been recognized as one of the nation's best employers by Fortune and Forbes magazines and a Top 10 Most Reputable U.S. Bank. More information is available at
